items.title: 1 Industrials Stock Worth Investigating and 2 That Underwhelm
items.summary: Whether you see them or not, industrials businesses play a crucial part in our daily activities. Unfortunately, this role also comes with a demand profile tethered to the ebbs and flows of the broader economy, and investors seem to be forecasting a downturn - over the past six months, the industry has pulled back by 2.5%. This performance is a noticeable divergence from the S&P 500’s 11.7% return.
